packages.name: Now Playing
packages.description: Shows the song playing on your PC (Spotify, YouTube in a browser, any app that shows up in Windows' media controls): title, artist, time, a progress bar and an audio spectrum.
packages.author: Yuniverse
packages.changelog: "Nothing playing" is no longer cut off at the top.

firmware.name: REVIVER v26
firmware.notes: Animation packages get screens of their own: the keyboard now stores up to 7 more images or GIFs next to your Image screen, each its own screen in the Screens tab, all playing with the PC off. Turn an animation package on in the Packages tab and TENET Hub stores it. Your current Image screen stays as it is. Everything from v25: PC stats labels (CPU, GPU, RAM or DISK), PC stats with temperature or usage, your own screen list, a screen for every screen package, changeable boot logo, live drawing, screen-off support.
